title: SqlCaptureProbe: tests pin the dropped-probe release, the registrar seam's default scope, and overlapping Mondrian-scoped probes; ownsCurrentEvent catches Throwable

criteria.given: a test opens a probe, drops it without close(), and forces GC in a bounded loop
criteria.then: activeProbeCount() returns to its baseline, the configured logger level is restored, and no saiku-sql-capture appender remains — pinning that the cleaner releases a dropped probe (saiku#2442 C1)

criteria.given: the package-private open(int, registrar) seam is used to open a probe
criteria.then: a test pins that the seam's default scope still claims the opening thread alone: a statement logged on another thread is not captured through it (saiku#2442 C2)

criteria.given: two overlapping probes are opened with MondrianStatementScope for different statements
criteria.then: a test logs under each statement's Locus on a worker thread and checks each probe keeps only its own statement's SQL (saiku#2442 C3)

criteria.given: a Scope whose owns() throws an Error
criteria.then: ownsCurrentEvent() catches Throwable, so an Error from a scope is treated as not-mine instead of flooding the log with a stack trace per event while the probe is open (the issue's nit), and the per-module test-count floor is raised to cover the new tests
